title: Speaking — Quiet places
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on quiet places.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
Where do you go when you want some quiet?
Does your ideal study place have any background sound?

part2.topic: Describe a quiet place you would like other people to know about.
points: what it looks or sounds like
part2.closing: and explain how it helps you relax or concentrate.

questions: How can cities protect quiet areas while attracting visitors?
Should busy public buildings have rooms where visitors can take a break from noise?
How has everyday life connected with quiet places changed for people of different ages?
